risk_if_not_implemented: Without Citizenship Requirements, trusted insiders may misuse access or act on conflicts of interest without detection or deterrence. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Regulatory / Legal / Contractual Financial Liability (R-EX-5), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Statutory / Regulatory / Contractual Change (MT-11), Fraud, Corruption and/or Intentional Criminal Conduct (MT-14), Workforce Shortage / Loss of Critical Skills / Labor Disruption (MT-25).

compensating_control_1.name: Personnel Screening
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to manage personnel security risk by screening individuals prior to authorizing access.
compensating_control_1.justification: Personnel Screening (HRS-05) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Citizenship Requirements (HRS-05.2) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with People applicability. Given the people-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Third-Party Personnel Security
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to control personnel security requirements including security roles and responsibilities for third-party providers.
compensating_control_2.justification: Third-Party Personnel Security (TPM-13) provides third-party oversight that compensates for the absence of Citizenship Requirements (HRS-05.2) by extending security obligations contractually and monitoring third-party risk in lieu of direct control. Given the people-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
